descriptions.resourceUtilizationRate: How much of CPU, memory, GPU, etc. you actually use relative to what you provisioned. Keeps over-provisioning visible.
descriptions.cloudWastePercentage: Portion spent on idle VMs, detached volumes, zombie snapshots. Drives shutdown/termination actions.
descriptions.powerScheduleAdherence: Whether start/stop automation works as planned for non-production workloads (nights/weekends).
descriptions.legacyResourcesPercentage: How many instances are still on old, less efficient families. Useful before migration waves.
descriptions.reservedInstancesCoverage: Percentage of instances covered by long-term commitments like RIs or Savings Plans.
descriptions.costEfficiencyPerService: Cost normalized per unit of service delivered (transaction, request, etc).
descriptions.containerDensity: Average number of pods/containers per node in Kubernetes clusters. Indicates packing efficiency.
descriptions.costPerWorkload: Average cost per application or workload, helps identify applications with disproportionate spending.
descriptions.effectiveSavingsRate: Net savings compared to pure on-demand pricing — unifies RI/SP/CUD coverage and utilization into a single number.
descriptions.commitmentDiscountWaste: How much of purchased RI/SP/CUD capacity remains unused — highlights over-commitment.
descriptions.computeCoveredByCommitments: Depth of rate coverage; low values signal on-demand instance leakage.
descriptions.costPerVcpuGpuHour: Normalizes cost to a technical unit, ideal for cross-provider price comparisons.
descriptions.budgetVsForecastVariation: How close your rolling forecast is to year-to-date budget. Adjusted variance proves planning discipline.
descriptions.cloudSpendVariation: The classic signal of over/under-budget spending; combines with detailed root cause analysis.
descriptions.forecastAccuracyRate: Predictive accuracy for capacity or values; guides forecast model adjustments.
descriptions.unallocatedCostPercentage: How much spending still lacks a tag or owner — keeps chargeback transparent.
descriptions.tagPolicyComplianceRate: Health of your tagging discipline; low values compromise all other KPIs.
descriptions.anomalyDetectionSavings: Savings achieved by detecting spending spikes early with alerts.

formulas.costEfficiencyPerService: Total Service Cost ÷ Number of Units Processed
formulas.containerDensity: Total Running Pods ÷ Total Cluster Nodes
formulas.costPerWorkload: Total Infrastructure Cost ÷ Number of Workloads
formulas.effectiveSavingsRate: (Savings from All Discount Instruments ÷ Equivalent On-Demand Spend)
formulas.computeCoveredByCommitments: (Compute Spend with Commitment Discount ÷ Total Compute Spend) × 100
formulas.costPerVcpuGpuHour: (Compute Cost per Hour ÷ Number of vCPUs or GPUs)
formulas.anomalyDetectionSavings: Sum of (Predicted Spike Cost - Cost at Shutdown)
